Born in Tiffin, Ohio, on 12 October 1836, to Alsatian parents.
He married Catharine Schmidt in Seneca County, Ohio, on 25 January 1859, and they moved west to Stephenson County,
Illinois, where their son John was born about 1860; Frank registered there, at Florence,
for the Civil War draft in July 1863. His was one of the seven families that built a small stone Catholic church in
Barclay Township, Black Hawk County, Iowa, in 1862, the start of Saint Francis parish.
The 1878 directory lists his land in sections 3, 7, 8 and 17; the stone church stood on section 3.
He died at Waterloo on 22 August 1899. Born in Bavaria about 1835, daughter of Casper Schmitt,
a carpenter, and Anna Ziegler. The family sailed from Bremen on the Columbia and landed at New York on 30 September
1853, bound for Ohio, where they settled in Seneca County; a Catharina is among the young Schmidts on the list.
They moved on to Stephenson County, Illinois, and then to Black Hawk County, Iowa.
She married Frank Fritz, and their son John was born in Illinois about 1860.
